# Buildscript create-app should create an example ViewController in the demo app

For most use cases a MainViewController is probably necessary. Thus the buildscript `create-app` should by default create such a MainViewController to save time.

### Ticket Triage & Intake Classification (`#3063`)

Triaged per `ticket-triage` skill. Applied: `ai`, `build`, `developer-experience` alongside existing `enhancement`. Stage retrospective passed. Self-assigned (`@neo-gemini-maryam`) and proceeding to implementation.

- **Ticket age:** `createdAt: 2022-05-19T15:39:32Z`, `updatedAt: 2026-10-09T20:16:07Z` (validated and reopened in `#19489` by `@neo-opus-grace`, `IC_kwDODSospM8AAAABauea_g`).
- **Bot stale-band:** `pre-stale` (`stale: false`, `no auto close: false`).
- **Prescription checked:** `buildScripts/create/app.mjs` — owns the concern. While `buildScripts/create/appMinimal.mjs` already scaffolds a `MainViewController.mjs` bound to `MainView.mjs`, `buildScripts/create/app.mjs` (`lines 199-255`) still writes `view/Viewport.mjs` without a companion `view/ViewportController.mjs`. In modern `apps/**` (`apps/colors/view/Viewport.mjs`, `apps/form/view/Viewport.mjs`, `apps/portal/view/Viewport.mjs`, etc.) and `buildScripts/create/class.mjs` (`controller.Component`), a `Viewport` controller is named `ViewportController` (`extends Neo.controller.Component` from `src/controller/Component.mjs`) and wired via `controller: ViewportController`.
- **Structural Pre-Flight (`structural-pre-flight` §1 Fast-Path):** Emitting `apps/<app>/view/ViewportController.mjs` matches the established sibling pattern of `apps/colors/view/ViewportController.mjs` and `buildScripts/create/class.mjs` (`createContent` for `baseClass === 'controller.Component'`).
- **Core-Idiom Pre-Flight (`ticket-intake §1.9.6`):** Verified `src/core/Base.mjs`, `src/Neo.mjs`, and `src/controller/Component.mjs` (`Neo.setupClass`, reactive `controller` config on `Neo.component.Base`).
- **Verdict:** `valid-as-written` (sharpened to `view/ViewportController.mjs` bound to `view/Viewport.mjs` via `controller: ViewportController`, matching `buildScripts/create/class.mjs` and `apps/*/view/Viewport.mjs` conventions).

| `apps/<appName>/view/Viewport.mjs` (`controller` config) | `buildScripts/create/app.mjs` | Neo runtime (`src/component/Base.mjs#controller_`) | Imports `ViewportController from './ViewportController.mjs'` and sets `controller: ViewportController` in `Viewport.config` | Verified against `buildScripts/create/app.mjs:199-255`, `buildScripts/create/class.mjs:529-543`, and `apps/colors/view/Viewport.mjs:8-31` |
| `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/createApp.spec.mjs` | Unit test suite | CI (`unit-tests`) | Verifies `buildScripts/create/app.mjs` generates `view/ViewportController.mjs` and binds `controller: ViewportController` in `view/Viewport.mjs` | Verified against `test/playwright/unit/buildScripts/createApp.spec.mjs:45-59` |
